description: The BUNDLED page and nothing else (hub#1716). `shell_retry` probes the network and NAVIGATES the main window, so it is the one command a remote origin must never reach: a page on a hub — or anything injected into one — could otherwise send the till wherever it liked. Declaring no `remote` block is how Tauri says local-only, and `local: true` says it out loud rather than by omission. The bundled offline page already inherits Tauri's core sets (`core:default` minus `core:app`, hub#2658) from `default.json` (which is `local: true` too), so this capability adds exactly one grant and no IPC surface of its own. Pinned by `tests/shell_offline.rs`.
